req.title: Chain N redirects
req.statement: The system shall redirect the client N times when GET /redirect/<n> is called, ending at /get on the final hop.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states GET /redirect/<n> must produce N-1 intermediate 302 responses and a final 200 at /get. I design tests covering: (1) a typical positive case with n=3 to verify the chain length and final destination; (2) boundary n=1 (minimum valid value, single hop directly to /get with 302 then 200); (3) boundary n=2 (one intermediate 302 then final 302 to /get); (4) negative case n=0 which violates the assert n>0 guard; (5) a larger n=5 to verify the full chain count. Each test uses follow_redirects=False to manually trace hops, ensuring exact status codes and Location headers are asserted, maximising mutation kill rate by checking exact values at each step.

tests.name: test_redirect_n3_positive_chain
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
n=3 is a valid positive integer
actions: Follow Location header manually for each hop
expected: First response: 302 with Location pointing to /redirect/2
Second response: 302 with Location pointing to /redirect/1
Third response: 302 with Location pointing to /get
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_redirect_n3_positive_chain():
    r1 = client.get('/redirect/3', follow_redirects=False)
    assert r1.status_code == 302
    loc1 = r1.headers['Location']
    assert '/redirect/2' in loc1

    r2 = client.get('/redirect/2', follow_redirects=False)
    assert r2.status_code == 302
    loc2 = r2.headers['Location']
    assert '/redirect/1' in loc2

    r3 = client.get('/redirect/1', follow_redirects=False)
    assert r3.status_code == 302
    loc3 = r3.headers['Location']
    assert '/get' in loc3

    r4 = client.get('/get', follow_redirects=False)
    assert r4.status_code == 200

test_redirect_n3_positive_chain()

tests.name: test_redirect_n5_full_chain_count
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
n=5 produces exactly 4 intermediate 302s and 1 final 302 to /get
actions: GET /redirect/5 with follow_redirects=True to count total hops
Also manually verify first hop is 302 to /redirect/4
expected: Manual first hop: 302 with Location containing /redirect/4
Full chain with follow_redirects=True ends at 200
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_redirect_n5_full_chain_count():
    r_first = client.get('/redirect/5', follow_redirects=False)
    assert r_first.status_code == 302
    loc = r_first.headers['Location']
    assert '/redirect/4' in loc

    hop_count = 0
    current = '/redirect/5'
    while True:
        resp = client.get(current, follow_redirects=False)
        if resp.status_code == 302:
            hop_count += 1
            current = resp.headers['Location']
            if current.startswith('http'):
                from urllib.parse import urlparse
                current = urlparse(current).path
        else:
            assert resp.status_code == 200
            break
    assert hop_count == 5

test_redirect_n5_full_chain_count()

tests.name: test_redirect_n1_location_is_get_not_redirect
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
n=1 must redirect directly to /get, NOT to /redirect/0
actions: Assert Location header ends at /get and does NOT contain /redirect
expected: Location does NOT contain /redirect (no off-by-one to /redirect/0)
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_redirect_n1_location_is_get_not_redirect():
    r = client.get('/redirect/1', follow_redirects=False)
    assert r.status_code == 302
    loc = r.headers.get('Location', '')
    assert '/get' in loc
    assert '/redirect/0' not in loc
    assert loc.endswith('/get') or loc.endswith('/get?') or '/get' in loc

test_redirect_n1_location_is_get_not_redirect()

tests.name: test_redirect_final_200_response_body
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
After following all redirects from /redirect/2, final /get returns JSON
actions: Assert response JSON contains expected keys from view_get
expected: JSON body contains keys: url, args, headers, origin
tests.executable:
import json
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_redirect_final_200_response_body():
    r = client.get('/redirect/2', follow_redirects=True)
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = json.loads(r.data.decode('utf-8'))
    assert 'url' in data
    assert 'args' in data
    assert 'headers' in data
    assert 'origin' in data
    assert 'form' not in data
    assert 'json' not in data

test_redirect_final_200_response_body()
